title: OpenAI finds a crack in Anthropic's business AI lead
excerpt: Although OpenAI trails Anthropic in business adoption, it won a moneymaking battle in July with its most advanced model, GPT-5.6 Sol.
content_html:
By Stephen Council

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Although OpenAI still straggles behind Anthropic in a closely watched measure of AI adoption among businesses, there's a spark of hope for CEO Sam Altman's company.

OpenAI has an advantage over its rival's priciest and most advanced model, according to new data from Ramp's AI Index. The data shows that Anthropic's Fable 5 model generated 75% as much spend as OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model did in July, indicating that Anthropic's top model was less popular among businesses. As Anthropic retains its lead in business adoption, weaker demand for top-end AI could ring alarm bells about customers' spending restraint.

Ramp, a financial technology firm, tracks data from bills and expenses for more than 70,000 US business customers to analyze spending on AI tools and products. While Ramp's customers represent a small subset of companies and generally skew toward smaller companies, its AI Index helps analysts and companies understand the competition among AI providers.

Fable got off to a rocky start for Anthropic; it was temporarily taken down by a government order, brought back on July 1, and then had its pricing adjusted throughout the month. The success of OpenAI's cheaper GPT-5.6 Sol threatens it. In the run-up to its IPO, Anthropic is staking its business on the idea that people will be willing to pay for its state-of-the-art tech rather than competitors' cheaper options.

Still, Anthropic has boasted dramatic growth this year and stays ahead of its rivals in adoption. In July, Ramp saw the share of US businesses paying for Anthropic AI products reach 43.5%, compared with 39.7% for OpenAI. Also, xAI climbed to 4%, and Google sank to 6.2%, down from 6.4%. Ramp economist Ara Kharazian told Business Insider that integrations via Google Workspace mean the number is likely a lowball estimate.

OpenAI, Anthropic, and xAI did not respond to requests for comment from Business Insider. Google declined to comment.

Kharazian said that the popularity of Chinese open-source models has grown, though not to the point he'd expect OpenAI and Anthropic to "freak out."'

As the number of businesses using OpenAI and Anthropic's products increases gradually, Ramp has seen much faster growth in the amount of money those businesses spend.

In July, the top 1% of AI spenders paid a median of $7,400 per employee for AI tools, Ramp found, versus less than $5,000 in June. Among the companies, the median firm spent about $12 per employee, versus about $11 in June.

AI agents have driven much of the industry's revenue growth this year and have become a major focus of development for both OpenAI and Anthropic. Kharazian said a large share of the AI spending Ramp tracked came from coding agents, which can trigger more tasks and cause costs to "spiral."

"That's why it's going up so quickly: It's scalable in a way that typical software is not," Kharazian said.

content_html_zh:
作者：Stephen Council 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

尽管在一项备受关注的企业人工智能采用率衡量标准中，OpenAI 仍然落后于 Anthropic，但首席执行官 Sam Altman 的公司仍看到了希望的火花。

根据 Ramp 人工智能指数的新数据，OpenAI 比竞争对手最昂贵、最先进的模型更具优势。 数据显示，7 月份 Anthropic 的 Fable 5 模型产生的支出是 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 模型的 75%，这表明 Anthropic 的顶级模型在企业中不太受欢迎。 随着 Anthropic 在商业采用方面保持领先地位，对高端人工智能的需求疲软可能会对客户的支出限制敲响警钟。

Ramp 是一家金融技术公司，跟踪 70,000 多家美国企业客户的账单和费用数据，以分析人工智能工具和产品的支出。 虽然 Ramp 的客户只代表一小部分公司，并且通常偏向小型公司，但其 AI 指数可以帮助分析师和公司了解 AI 提供商之间的竞争。

《神鬼寓言》对于 Anthropic 来说起步并不顺利。它被政府命令暂时下架，并于 7 月 1 日恢复，然后整个月都调整了价格。 OpenAI 更便宜的 GPT-5.6 Sol 的成功对其构成了威胁。 在首次公开募股（IPO）前夕，Anthropic 将其业务押注于这样的想法：人们愿意为其最先进的技术付费，而不是竞争对手更便宜的选择。

尽管如此，Anthropic 今年仍取得了惊人的增长，并在采用率方面领先于竞争对手。 7 月份，Ramp 发现美国企业为 Anthropic AI 产品付费的比例达到 43.5%，而 OpenAI 的这一比例为 39.7%。 此外，xAI 攀升至 4%，谷歌则从 6.4% 下降至 6.2%。 Ramp 经济学家 Ara Kharazian 告诉《商业内幕》，通过 Google Workspace 进行集成意味着这个数字可能是一个低估的估计。

OpenAI、Anthropic 和 xAI 没有回应 Business Insider 的置评请求。 谷歌拒绝发表评论。

Kharazian 表示，中国的开源模型越来越受欢迎，但还没有达到他预期 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 会“惊慌失措”的程度。

随着使用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 产品的企业数量逐渐增加，Ramp 看到这些企业花费的金额增长得更快。

Ramp 发现，7 月份，最富有的 1% 的人工智能消费者为每位员工支付的人工智能工具费用中位数为 7,400 美元，而 6 月份的费用还不到 5,000 美元。 在这些公司中，公司每位员工的平均支出约为 12 美元，而 6 月份约为 11 美元。

人工智能代理今年推动了该行业的大部分收入增长，并成为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的主要发展重点。 Kharazian 表示，Ramp 跟踪的人工智能支出中很大一部分来自编码代理，这可能会触发更多任务并导致成本“螺旋上升”。

“这就是它增长如此之快的原因：它的可扩展性是典型软件所不具备的，”卡拉齐安说。
